_note: This file is the single source of truth for both the website content and (later) the chatbot's grounded knowledge base. Keep it in sync — when the owner changes a price or hours, edit it here once.

business.name: Zeytin
business.address: 14 Canal View Road, Faisalabad, Punjab, Pakistan
business.ambience: Warm, wood-and-brass interior with an open charcoal grill station, indoor seating plus a small outdoor terrace (8 tables, weather permitting)

hours.notes: Closed on the first Monday of every month for deep cleaning.

booking_policy.large_party_note: Parties of 11 or more must call or WhatsApp the restaurant directly to arrange a private setup.
booking_policy.hold_time_note: Tables are held for 15 minutes past the reservation time before being released.
booking_policy.cancellation_policy: Cancel or reschedule up to 2 hours before your reservation with no charge.
booking_policy.outdoor_seating_note: Terrace seating is weather-dependent and cannot be guaranteed in advance.

menu.dietary_notes: No alcohol is served. We can prepare most main courses without dairy on request. We are not a certified nut-free kitchen — please inform your server of any severe allergies before ordering.
menu.kids_menu: A simplified kids' platter (grilled chicken strips, fries, and a soft drink) is available for Rs. 650, not listed on the main menu — just ask.

services_offered: Private terrace booking for groups of 6–10 (subject to availability)
Birthday/celebration setups (mention when booking — simple table decoration, no charge, 48 hours notice required)
things_not_offered: No delivery service at this time (takeaway/pickup only)
No walk-in guarantee during weekend dinner hours — booking strongly recommended Thu–Sat evenings

faqs.a: Yes, free parking for around 12 cars directly outside the restaurant, plus street parking on Canal View Road.
Yes, high chairs are available and there is a simple kids' platter on request.
Yes, but a table can't be guaranteed without a reservation, especially Thursday to Saturday evenings.
No formal dress code — smart casual is typical.
No, Zeytin does not serve alcohol.

faqs.q: Can I bring a cake for a birthday?
faqs.a: Yes, outside cakes are welcome with no cake-cutting fee. Please let the staff know when you arrive.
